Yes, there is a map compass control (a round button with the letter "N") in the bottom-left corner. It is positioned so that it overlaps the bottom-left corner of the dark card (the "stage" showing the Strava graphic) and also slightly overlaps the light gray background area below it.

Here is a description of what I see in the bottom 25% of the image, from top to bottom:

1.  **The Lower Half of the Dark Card:** This area contains the white "STRAVA" logo, followed by activity statistics in two rows: "Distance 6.73 km", "Pace 4:50 /km", and "Time 32:35". Below that is a small white shoe icon.
2.  **Footer Text:** At the very bottom inside the dark card, there is small text reading "Transparent background — shown on dark".
3.  **The Compass Control:** A dark circular button with a white "N" is located at the bottom-left vertex of the image. It sits on top of the rounded corner of the black card and extends down onto the light gray background beneath it.

**Overlap Assessment:** The compass button does appear to be overlapping the border of the dark card stage incorrectly. It looks like a floating UI element (likely for rotating or orienting a map view) that has been placed too far to the left or bottom, causing it to cover the edge of the preview card.
